notes: Mage stats: Intelligence, Wisdom, Spirit, Willpower, Focus and Vigor, bought with essence in Character (F2) > Stats, with a paid respec. Element roots: develop any of the five with essence for stronger, cheaper spells of that element. Mix traits now work in play (Steam scalds, Lightning chains, Ice freezes, Sand blinds and more). Your gear is converted to the new stats on the first start. Players on older versions cannot join 0.1.4 lobbies: everyone updates.

Settings (Esc > Settings): window mode and resolution, vsync, text size, start zoom, damage numbers and rebindable keys. Updates are now signed: from this version on the game only installs updates signed with the release key. Spell bar cooldowns no longer cover the mana cost; the allied dummies moved clear of the spell bar.

Save failsafes: safe saving with a previous-save copy, daily backups (newest 5), automatic recovery from an interrupted or damaged save, and nothing in a save is ever dropped. Your 0.1.x profile is upgraded on the first start (the old file is kept as .bak). Do not go back to 0.1.0 or 0.1.1 afterwards: they cannot read the new format.
Update test: checks that the in-game updater moves 0.1.0 players to a new version. No gameplay changes.
First shipping version: spell designer (tiers 1 and 2), three zones and the Hollow Warden, co-op lobbies for up to 4 players, auto-updater.
